selected_skill.name: prometheus-configuration
selected_skill.selection_reason: This skill is a direct match for a Prometheus setup task covering metric collection, scrape configuration, service discovery, and recording rules. It does not require private accounts or sensitive external access.

design_goals: Keep the task as a configuration-build task rather than a repair or incident task.
Make with-skill and without-skill differ only by environment/skills and the runtime skill copy logic.
Force action-level Prometheus work around discovery, relabeling, recording rules, and alert rules.

input_data.notes: Reference shape for HTTP request counter and latency histogram metrics.
Reference shape for inventory-driven scrape configuration.
Reference sample for exposition format details and metric families.
Scenario reference for Harbor component-oriented monitoring.

task_shape.runtime: single container with Prometheus plus multiple metrics endpoints
task_shape.solver_action: author a working monitoring bundle from contracts and inventory data

intended_failures: Naive solutions hardcode static targets instead of keeping the bundle inventory-driven.
Naive discovery globs in a shadow manifest and scrapes an extra target.
Recording rules omit service labels or miscompute histogram p95 values.
Alert rules are absent or do not distinguish ticket versus page severity.
verifier_focus: Validate the final report contract and recompute expected summary values independently.
Check that exactly the contract services are active before the dynamic inventory test.
Check that recording rules and alert rules are loaded and evaluable.
Add a new inventory file during verification to confirm directory-driven discovery works.
Protect input data and ensure the report can be regenerated from the configured bundle.
with_without_difference_policy: Only environment/skills/ and the corresponding runtime skill-copy logic may differ between with-skill and without-skill variants.
iteration_notes: Do not modify the selected skill.
Do not use wording that turns the task into an incident-recovery prompt.
without-skill failure should remain action-level, not a mere formatting mismatch.
README comparison metrics must be filled only after completed task-level experiments.

without_skill.failure_shape: smoke-probe was not discovered from new inventory file
auxiliary inventory targets were scraped or smoke target never settled
smoke-probe was not discovered from new inventory file
